newsitem.title: USA: Rhone-Poulenc's Taxotere available in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc's Taxotere available in Japan.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc said Friday that its anticancer agent Taxotere is now commercially available in Japan for the treatment of non-small-cell lung and breast cancer.
According to Rhone-Poulenc, Taxotere is the first of a class called taxoids to receive approval and to be marketed in Japan, which is the second-largest market for cancer chemotherapy in the world.
Taxotere, which is prepared from the needles of the European yew tree, inhibits cancer cell growth and prohibits cancer cell division, which ultimately causes cell death.

To date, Taxotere has been approved for use in 51 countries, and in 24 of those countries it is the only agent of its kind to be approved for treatment of patients with advanced non-small-cell lung cancer, the company said.
